note: Added in 1.26.10 behind the Upcoming Creator Features experiment. Lets a single block definition span multiple block positions (2-4 parts) and treats all parts as a unified block (like Doors). Enables the `minecraft:multi_block_part` state; `direction` controls whether parts stack `up` or `down`. When `minecraft:selection_box` is `true`, individual part AABBs are combined into one outline. Requires `minecraft:movable` defined outside permutations (with `movement_type` set to `popped` or `immovable`); `minecraft:placement_filter` cannot be defined in permutations.

generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Block Multi Block
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

fields.title: Direction
fields.description: The direction the block parts are placed starting from 'minecraft:multi_block_part' permutation '0' to permutation 'parts'. Default value is 'up'.

fields.title: Enabled States
fields.description: Which state to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:multi_block_part"].

fields.title: Parts
fields.description: The number of block parts, this sets the value for state 'minecraft:multi_block_part'. Default value is '2'.
